features.title: Configurable Service Dependency Topology with Persistence
acceptance: Service dependencies stored in SQLite database instead of hardcoded constants
REST API endpoints for CRUD operations on service dependencies (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE)
Correlator uses database-backed dependencies for cascade graph construction
Frontend UI for viewing and managing dependencies (analyst/admin roles)
Default dependencies seeded on first run for backward compatibility
Role-based access: viewers can read, analysts/admins can mutate
Audit trail records all dependency mutations
implementation: backend/app/core/database.py: add service_dependencies table to init_db
backend/app/services/correlator.py: replace SERVICE_DEPENDENCIES constant with DB lookup
backend/app/api/dependencies.py: new API router with CRUD endpoints
backend/app/api/logs.py: import EventCorrelator after DB init (no change needed)
tests: backend/tests/test_dependencies.py: new test file for dependency CRUD and correlator integration

features.title: Configurable Anomaly Detection Thresholds with Persistence
acceptance: Anomaly detection thresholds (anomaly threshold, severity bands) stored in SQLite database
REST API endpoints for GET/PUT threshold configuration (analyst/admin roles)
Detector uses database-backed thresholds at evaluation time
Default thresholds seeded on first run for backward compatibility
Frontend UI for viewing and adjusting thresholds (analyst/admin roles)
Role-based access: viewers can read, analysts/admins can mutate
Audit trail records all threshold mutations
